```python
import pandas as pd
file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/54612da3-fd56-4941-80f4-5eb82330de25.xlsx"
xl = pd.ExcelFile(file_path)
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name=xl.sheet_names[0])
print("Sheet names:", xl.sheet_names)
print("Columns:", df.columns.tolist())

# Find header rows
steam_start = df.index[df['Number'] == 'Steam'][0]
diesel_start = df.index[df['Number'] == 'Diesel'][0]

# Extract steam locomotive rows between headers
steam_df = df.iloc[steam_start+1:diesel_start]
print("Steam rows count:", len(steam_df))
print(steam_df[['Number', 'Type/Wheel Configuration']])

# Wheel arrangements list
wheel_arrangements = steam_df['Type/Wheel Configuration'].dropna().tolist()
print("Wheel arrangements:", wheel_arrangements)
```
